brands.name: Miller Surfboards
brands.short_description: Jacksonville, Florida custom surfboards by Josh Miller — grovelers, shortboards, and longboards.

models.name: Phantom
models.description: Missing link between your standard shortboard and your fish. Ride the phantom 3-4 inches shorter than your normal shortboard. Board has fuller outline more volume, combined with a moderate single to double concave. Quad+1 set up. Recommended size range: 5'0" to 6'6".

models.name: Red Label
models.description: Enhanced volume, single to double concave. Thruster set up. Slightly more volume than your standard shortboard. Available in round-squash or swallow tail. Recommended size range: 5'0" to 6'6".

models.name: Black Label
models.description: Enhanced volume, single to double concave, and a quad+1 fin set up makes this board a very good all around board. Available in round-squash or swallow tail. Recommended size range: 5'0" to 6'6".

models.name: Gut Wagon
models.description: Short wide and thick. Low rocker with a single to double concave with V off the tail. Board is a wave catching machine! Best to order 4-6 inches shorter than your normal shortboard. Available in round-squash, swallow tail, or rocket tail. Recommended size range: 5'0" to 6'6".

models.name: Zero
models.description: Low entry rocker with double to panel v out the tail. Board is a super versatile small wave board. That comes as a Quad+1. Recommended size range: 5'0" to 6'6".

models.name: M-1
models.description: Fuller outline, wider tail block, all around more volume, combined with a moderate single to double concave makes this board a good groveler. Best in knee to head high surf. Recommended size range: 5'0" to 6'6".

models.name: M-2
models.description: High performance go to shortboard for experienced surfers. Single concave, available in round-squash or swallow tail. Recommended size range: 5'0" to 6'6".

models.name: Grommet
models.description: Slimmer version of the Gut Wagon, single to double concave. Quad+1. Slightly more volume than your standard shortboard. Available in round-squash or swallow tail. Recommended size range: 5'0" to 6'8".

models.name: Frank The Tank
models.description: Slight single concave in the nose that flows out to rolled v off the tail. Classic all arounder that will work in most conditions. Comes standard as a 2+1 setup. Recommended size range: 9'0" to 9'6".

models.name: Time Machine
models.description: Old school all the way! 50/50 rails with a spooned single concave in the nose that flows out to rolled belly of the tail. This is the ultimate nose rider. Recommended size range: 9'0" to 9'6".

models.name: Mini Tanker
models.description: This is the Frank The Tank model shrunk down and compressed to a minimal shape. Recommended size range: 8'0" to 9'6".
